candidate.title: Atypical haemolytic uraemic syndrome
candidate.diseaseDescription: Consolidated complement-mediated aHUS map: inherited and acquired regulatory defects, alternative-pathway amplification, terminal complement, endothelial and platelet injury, renal TMA, haemolysis, thrombocytopenia and kidney dysfunction, with haemolysis–heme feedback and verified C5 targets. Human associations, cell experiments and animal perturbations retain explicit study-system limits. THBD disease causality is disputed. Excludes STEC-HUS, TTP, secondary TMA as disease entities, DGKE and cobalamin-related TMA.
candidate.releaseNote: Consolidated overview replaces study-fragmented navigation. All word-cloud entities are visible by default. Added regulatory convergence, factor B/convertases, terminal pathway, endothelial injury/repair, platelets/fibrin, clinical triad and heme amplification. THBD association explicitly disputed. Source systems/limits retained; independent scientific review and calibration pending.

entities.label: Complement-regulatory gene variants
entities.description: Selected CFH, CFI and CD46 susceptibility variants; variant-specific functional evidence and incomplete penetrance are retained.

entities.label: Factor H regulatory activity
entities.description: Surface recognition and complement regulation; patient autoantibody binding and inhibition are studied in biochemical assays.

entities.label: Anti-factor H autoantibodies
entities.description: Patient antibodies to factor H; studied C-terminal binding inhibits surface recognition.

entities.label: CFHR1/CFHR3 deficiency
entities.description: Inherited deficiency associated with anti-factor H autoantibodies in a selected cohort; not sufficient by itself to establish disease.

entities.label: Factor I regulatory activity
entities.description: Complement protease activity; selected CFI variants impair secretion or surface C3b cleavage.

entities.label: CD46 surface regulation
entities.description: Membrane cofactor protein function; R69W/A304V cell challenge experiments retain variant and model limits.

entities.label: C3 susceptibility variants
entities.description: Selected C3 variants in a low-C3 patient series; both gain-of-function and inactivating variants were reported.

entities.label: Alternative complement pathway dysregulation
entities.description: Failure to regulate alternative complement activity; fluid phase and endothelial-surface readouts are distinct.

entities.label: aHUS patient serum
entities.description: Patient serum sampled during acute disease or remission, tested on human endothelial cells.

entities.label: Endothelial C5b-9 deposition
entities.description: Terminal complement membrane attack complex on endothelial surfaces; assay readout is not equivalent to clinical disease.

entities.label: C5a–C5aR1 signalling
entities.description: Terminal complement inflammatory signalling, genetically and pharmacologically perturbed in distinct mouse models.

entities.label: Renal thrombotic microangiopathy
entities.description: Renal small-vessel pathology in mouse experiments; human trial outcomes use their specified TMA definitions.

entities.label: Macrovascular thrombosis
entities.description: Separate outcome in factor H mutant mice; not substituted for renal TMA or universal human disease.

entities.label: aHUS susceptibility / penetrance
entities.description: Human genetic association and incomplete penetrance; not a deterministic genotype-to-disease pathway.

entities.label: Eculizumab exposure
entities.description: C5 inhibitor exposure in endothelial assays and separate uncontrolled clinical trials.

entities.label: Clinical TMA response
entities.description: Trial-specific platelet and TMA event-free outcomes; not identical across studies.

entities.label: Loss of kidney function
entities.description: Renal impairment or recovery endpoints in selected aHUS trials; reversal is not assured.

entities.label: Complement C5 cleavage
entities.description: Terminal complement target; cleavage generates C5a and C5b, with subsequent MAC formation.

entities.label: Factor B gain-of-function variants
entities.description: Selected CFB variants enhance alternative-pathway convertase formation or resist regulatory inactivation; not all CFB variants are pathogenic.

entities.label: Alternative-pathway C3/C5 convertases
entities.description: Amplifying surface convertase activity; C3bBb and downstream C5-convertase function are consolidated for readability.

entities.label: Endothelial activation / injury
entities.description: Complement-associated membrane injury and prothrombotic activation; cell-repair responses and animal/human evidence remain distinct.

entities.label: Platelet activation / aggregation
entities.description: Platelet activation, aggregation and procoagulant microparticle release observed in selected human serum/platelet assays.

entities.label: Fibrin / microvascular thrombi
entities.description: Complement-associated fibrin deposition in endothelial assays and glomerular microthrombi in mice.

entities.label: Microangiopathic haemolysis
entities.description: Mechanical erythrocyte fragmentation accompanying TMA; distinguish from primary complement lysis of erythrocytes.

entities.label: Platelet consumption / thrombocytopenia
entities.description: Reduced circulating platelet counts accompanying renal TMA; platelet consumption inferred from the clinical mechanism, not directly quantified in every experiment.

entities.label: Haemolysis-derived heme
entities.description: Heme released during hemolysis can amplify complement on endothelium in experimental systems; whole-loop sufficiency in patients is unproven.

entities.label: Complement-amplifying triggers
entities.description: Infection, pregnancy and other stressors can precede disease in susceptible individuals; not sufficient causes and not a reclassification of all secondary TMAs.

entities.label: Thrombomodulin regulation (disputed aHUS genetics)
entities.description: THBD variants altered complement-regulatory activity in original cell studies; later human cohort analysis did not support significant disease causality.

entities.label: Endothelial von Willebrand factor
entities.description: Weibel–Palade body release and endothelial-anchored VWF connect complement challenge to hemostatic responses; experimental conditions are retained.

therapies.name: Eculizumab
therapies.mechanismOfAction: Binds C5 and inhibits cleavage to C5a/C5b, preventing terminal MAC formation.
therapies.indication: Adult and pediatric patients; weight-based pediatric dosing with aHUS to inhibit complement-mediated TMA; not indicated for STEC-HUS.
therapies.trialPhase: Approved US indication; pivotal aHUS studies open-label and single-arm
limitations: No head-to-head superiority claim or universal renal recovery implied.
Serious meningococcal infection risk; vaccination does not eliminate risk.
Full safety, dosing, discontinuation and transplant management are outside this map.

therapies.name: Ravulizumab
therapies.mechanismOfAction: Binds C5 and inhibits cleavage to C5a/C5b, preventing terminal MAC formation.
therapies.indication: Adults and children at least one month old with aHUS to inhibit complement-mediated TMA; not indicated for STEC-HUS.
therapies.trialPhase: Approved US indication; pivotal aHUS studies open-label and single-arm
limitations: No head-to-head superiority claim or universal renal recovery implied.
Serious meningococcal infection risk; vaccination does not eliminate risk.
Full safety, dosing, discontinuation and transplant management are outside this map.
